title: Walker 2.0
author: MedicineTime6681
selftext: Me and my friend played this a lot when we were kids. Walker on amiga. Omg We dreamed about doing our own version …and today decades later it’s done! Used codex for the most part. Game rated R,😅 please give me a review. Keyboard and mouse only (just as in the original) https://andersprintz.itch.io/blast-from-the-past
